answer: Persistent Attention Ledger: each identity accrues a pigment of history from continuous, verifiable micro-participation, and the agent's rank derives solely from uninterrupted tenure. A quartz threshold of elapsed time must be crossed before an identity's actions affect shared state, so fresh clones stay inert. The global atlas of tenure curves is enforced by the rule that rank resets on any gap exceeding a fixed window. An attacker must pay sustained hourly attention across many parallel personas for weeks, so the cost scales with calendar time per identity rather than with one-time fees.
